Name: Desert Afforestation Area
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Add tree plantations so that the standard desert MAP does not have to be filled with trees.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12089]Dam[/url].
It will be possible to access the afforestation area from a specific map of the dam.

Added [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] compatibility
If you have SVE installed, use Minecart to move MAP.
Access can be found on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14219?tab=images]IMAGES[/url] page.

Compatible with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26195]Explorable West Forest[/url]".

Currently, English, Japanese and Chinese are supported.
